root_cause_diagnosis.primary_defect_1: Old 24-slot calibration in pklot_pucpr_calibration.json was manually drawn over the foreground roadway driveway (y in [0.35, 0.54] and [0.58, 0.88]), rather than actual parking spaces. The boxes were 100x216px (over 4x larger than genuine bays).
root_cause_diagnosis.primary_defect_2: The classifier was trained strictly on CNRPark+EXT (pale gray concrete/gravel in Pisa), creating a catastrophic domain shift when exposed to Brazilian dark asphalt with intense canopy shadows.

reproduction_of_audit_result.finding: Confirmed: Classifier predicted 348/396 (100%) observations as occupied.
